contexts.text: That thus He could save the human race.
That the human race would have perished together with the Church. Signified, Explained. AC 637. AC 2243:7.

The universal human race on the Earth is like the body with its parts, in which the Church is like the heart... and with disjunction of the human race from the Lord, it would at once perish... AC 2054. AC 9276:7.
This, too, was the reason of the Lord's Advent into the world: unless... He had come, the universal human race on this Earth would have perished...
The reason the human race can never live, unless conjoined with the Lord through Heaven and the World of Spirits, is that, regarded in himself, man is viler than the brutes...
Because the celestial acknowledge that the human race is nothing but filth, and in itself excrementitious and infernal...
The universal human race. Signified.
Who would save the universal human race.
The human race would have perished. AC 1676:end. AC 1775. AC 2034:8.
From love towards the universal human race He fought... AC 1690:end. AC 1789.
The Lord's life was love towards the universal human race...
He wanted to become certain that He should save the human race. Treated of.
The reward of His victories was the salvation of the universal human race. AC 1793:2.
Finally, mere falsities and evils possessed the human race. Signified.
The salvation of the human race was His only consolation...
It treats of... the conjunction of the Lord through His Human Essence with the human race. AC 1986.
(By these human internals) the human race is most present under the Lord's eyes.
He thus delivered the human race from destruction.
On Heaven... depends the World of Spirits; and on this again the human race.

In the union of His Human Essence with the Divine one the Lord regarded His conjunction with the human race... The inmost joy He had was the salvation of the human race as regarded in His union with His Father.
That a conjunction was effected of the Supreme Divine with the human race through the Human of the Lord made Divine...
The Lord's grief and anxiety over the human race... Treated of.
The Lord's perception about the human race, that it was in evil and falsity. Treated of.
Because the greatest part of the human race are in external worship...
It was thus made known to Him... what was the quality of the human race which... would be saved by Him.
Thus through the Word Heaven is conjoined with the human race.
His perception from the Divine concerning the human race, of what quality it was. Signified. AC 2219.

The reason the Lord wanted to depart from this perception (was) that His perception from the Divine, and the consequent thought about the human race, that it was such, struck Him with horror; for the Lord's love towards the universal human race was so great that He wanted... to save all to eternity.
That the human race was in such great evil. Signified.
The Lord's grief from love towards the human race; and intercession, that still good is adjoined, although they are evil. Signified. AC 2318:2.
The Lord's intercession for the human race was when He was in the world...

With the Lord when in the world there was no other life than the life of love towards the universal human race... This life is the veriest celestial life itself by which He united Himself to the Divine, and the Divine to Himself; Esse itself or Jehovah is nothing else than mercy, which is of love towards the universal human race... AC 4735:2.
(His) anxiety at the state of the human race. Signified. AC 2283.
The human race could no longer have been saved unless the Lord had come into the world... AC 2776:3.
For without a Church somewhere in the world the human race could not subsist, because there would be no conjunction of it with Heaven. AC 2853:3.
These things are said from the zeal of love towards the universal human race... This love directed the Lord's thoughts while He was still in the maternal human.
Out of consideration for the human race...
That by this union salvation might reach the human race, in which there was no longer left any celestial and spiritual good, nor even any natural good.
As this light could no longer affect the human race...
Unless this (infernal) fury were continually repelled by the Lord, the whole human race would perish.
As the human race by the life of evil and the derivative persuasions of falsity had become utterly perverted...
That the Lord is the salvation of the human race: unless this becomes affirmative...
After the human race had removed itself from the good of love and of charity, this light could no longer be produced through Heaven... which should penetrate even to the human race...
Instead of bread the Angels perceive... the things which are from the Lord, consequently, His love towards the universal human race...
(Without these external bonds) the human race would perish.
They who... have received His Love towards the universal human race... But they who... have not received love towards the human race...
(This is) from the love or mercy of the Lord towards the universal human race.
Yet they are the most bitter enemies... even of the human race...
(Without the communication of Heaven through the Church the human race) would become like beasts devoid of internal and external bonds...
They foresaw... that thus the human race would perish...
Men are such, that they want to worship that of which they can have some perception and thought... This is general with the human race...
The good of charity has this in it because it descends from the Lord's love towards the universal human race, which love is mercy, because all the human race is constituted in miseries. AC 9219.
In the Hell (of the colon) are they who... without conscience have wanted to destroy the human race...
The Angels are horrified that the human race is such.
Divine love is called mercy, because from itself the human race is in Hell...
Food... when predicated of the Lord = the good of the Divine love to save the human race.
To do the will of Him who sent Him, and to perfect His work = to save the human race.
Life from the Lord is the life of love towards the universal human race.
In this love the Lord is present; for He loves the universal human race.
The Divine did not create the universe for the sake of any other end than that the human race might come forth, and thence Heaven; for the human race is the seminary of Heaven...
Not for the sake of Himself, but for the sake of the human race: not from His own glory, but from love; for He wills to be conjoined with the human race...
In the relative sense, the Sabbath represented the conjunction of the Lord's Divine Human with the human race.
Without the Word there is no conjunction (with Heaven)... and if there is no conjunction, the human race perishes. AC 9400:2.

Hence the human race is the ultimate in order, in which ceases, and in which rests Heaven; and therefore the Lord... always provides that there is a Church with the human race in which there is truth Divine revealed... By means of this there exists a nexus which holds together the human race with the Heavens...
The end of creation is the human race, in order that from it there may be a Heaven... The Angels say that an Earth without the human race cannot subsist...
The conjunction of Heaven with the human race, that is, the conjunction of the Lord through Heaven with it, is effected by means of those who are in the good of charity...
That the communication and conjunction of the Lord with the human race is such, is evident from...
That without a Church on the earth the human race would perish. References.
The fewness of the human race relatively to the Infinite Creator. Shown.
The tables were written from the two transits = by which is the conjunction of the Lord with the human race; that is, of Heaven with the world.
As the conjunction of the Lord with the human race... by means of the Word, is mentioned, we must say how this is. Explained.
The human race subsists by means of Heaven... In order, therefore, that Heaven may subsist, and, from conjunction with it, the human race, the Word has been provided by the Lord...
If this (order is not maintained by governors) the human race will perish...
On the conjunction of Heaven with the human race. General article.
It follows, that such is the connection and conjunction of Heaven with the human race, that the one subsists from the other...
[Swedenborg's footnote]: Hence, unless there were a Church where the Word is and by it the Lord is known, in this Earth, the human race here would perish. References.
That Heaven and Hell are from the human race. General article. LJ 14. LJ 19, Illustrated.
If there were no equilibrium... Heaven and Hell would perish, and with them the whole human race...
That all Spirits and Angels are from the human race.
That the procreations of the human race on earth will never cease. General article.
That the human race is the basis upon which Heaven is founded. Explained.

The prior cannot be separated from the posterior... thus not... the angelic Heaven from the human race, nor the human race from the angelic Heaven. Therefore it has been so provided... that the one should perform a mutual work for the other; namely, the angelic Heaven for the human race, and the human race for the angelic Heaven...

(Thus) such is the connection of the angelic Heaven and the human race, that the one subsists from the other; and the angelic Heaven without the human race is like a house without a foundation; for in it Heaven ceases, and upon it it rests.
So it is when man passes... into the Spiritual World... then, being a Spirit, he does not subsist upon his Own basis, but upon the general basis which is the human race.
(Thus) the human race and the angelic Heaven make one, and subsist mutually and in turn; and it is therefore impossible for the one to be taken away from the other.
That the human race is the seminary of Heaven. (Explained.)
It is possible for the human race on one Earth to perish, which takes place when it completely separates itself from the Divine...
But although, by separation from the Divine, the human race should perish upon one Earth still it would remain permanently upon others...

I have been told from Heaven, that the human race would have perished upon this Earth, so that at the present day there would not have existed one, unless the Lord had come into the world, and had put on the Human in this Earth, and had made it Divine; and also unless the Lord had given here such a Word that it might be for a basis and for conjunction with the angelic Heaven.

For the angelic Heaven is the end for the sake of which is the human race; and the human race is the end for the sake of which is the visible Heaven, and the Earths therein... Hence, too, it may be evident, that the human race will never cease.
The human race is the basis, containant, and support of the Heavens; and with men and in them is the Word...
That the Divine Providence has for an end a Heaven from the human race. General article.
He regards what is infinite and eternal in the human race, from which He forms it His Heaven.
That the end of creation is a Heaven from the human race. General article.
The love of the sex... has been implanted from creation in the very soul of man... for the sake of the propagation of the human race.
The use (of conjugial love) is the propagation of the human race, and thence of the angelic Heaven. And as this use was the end of ends of creation...
For all things are for the sake of the human race, that from it there may be an angelic Heaven...
Because the use of conjugial love is the most excellent of all uses; for thence is the procreation of the human race, and from the human race an angelic Heaven.
In creating the universe God intended one end, which was an angelic Heaven from the human race... AE 294.
The world is a complex of uses in successive order for the human race, from which is the angelic Heaven.
Thus, if the human race were lacking, Spirits could be remitted into a like state...
How the human race was afterwards inverted. (Explained.)
He kept up a contempt and a kind of hatred against the universal human race...
As... the Lord came into the world to save the human race, He said, I thirst; by which is meant that from Divine love He willed and longed for the salvation of the human race.
The human race is as it were the base of a column, or as the foundation of a palace, for the Heavens... AE 1085:2.

Therefore, unless the Lord had come into the world... the Heavens which are from the inhabitants of this Earth would have been translated elsewhere, and all the human race on this Earth would have perished in eternal death.
The Word is blasphemed by this, that they believed... that the Divine had... rejected from itself the human race...

The mineral kingdom is for the vegetable kingdom; this is for the animal kingdom; and the latter and the former are for the human race, in order that this may be of service to the Lord for the doing of uses to the neighbour.

Thus the Divine could no longer do this work through its own Divine in the human race; for... the human race had so removed itself... that not even with a single one was there natural good from a spiritual origin.

The Last Judgment which is described by the Flood was accomplished from the Divine which yet remained in the human race... The ultimate was then the Divine in the remnant of the human race. And when this ceased, and in order that the human race might be saved, the Divine Itself was pleased to make itself [the last]...
So it would be if the human race were to perish; thus, also, the angelic Heavens would from a like cause go to destruction.
Therefore, the basis and foundation of the Heavens is the human race.

5. 3. A natural origin was added, in order that at the same time there might be material and fixed things, for the sake of the end of the procreation of the human race, which is not possible except in ultimates, where there is fulness; and in order that from the human race as a seminary the inhabitants of the Spiritual World... might come forth. This is the first and last end of creation.
That in the widest sense the human race is the neighbour... Explained.
